title: PRISM-BENCH: Diagnosing Grounded and Faithful Multimodal Reasoning Beyond Final-Answer Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2610.36554v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Final-answer accuracy reports whether a vision-language model was right, but not whether its answer was grounded in the image, whether its stated reasoning reflects that evidence, or what the answer cost to produce. Those are the properties that decide whether a system can be deployed. We present PRISM-BENCH, a benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated questions spanning five under-represented reasoning categories, in which every item carries an idealized reasoning trace written by one human annotator and validated by another. The traces support two diagnostics that accuracy cannot provide. A perception probe, in which the model answers from a description it wrote itself, attributes roughly 85% of frontier-model failures to misperception and places the bottleneck at grounding. Trace alignment predicts answer correctness for all 25 systems tested (macro AUROC 0.66) and survives length control, so it measures reasoning content and not verbosity.

translated_title: PRISM-BENCH：超越最终答案准确率的有据可依且忠实可靠的多模态推理诊断
translated_abstract: 最终答案准确率只能反映视觉语言模型是否答对了，却无法说明其答案是否真正立足于图像、其陈述的推理过程是否反映了该证据，以及生成答案付出了什么代价。而这些正是决定一个系统能否被部署的关键属性。我们提出PRISM-BENCH，这是一个包含1,000道专家精心策划问题的基准，涵盖五个代表性不足的推理类别，其中每个条目都附有一条由一名人类标注者撰写、并由另一名标注者验证的理想化推理轨迹。这些轨迹支持两种准确率无法提供的诊断方法。感知探测要求模型基于自己撰写的描述作答，结果将前沿模型约85%的失败归因于感知错误，并将瓶颈定位在视觉定位能力上。轨迹对齐能够预测所有25个被测系统的答案正确性（宏观AUROC为0.66），且在长度控制下依然有效，因此它衡量的是推理内容而非冗长程度。
tldr: PRISM-BENCH是一个包含1000道专家标注问题的多模态推理基准，通过感知探测和轨迹对齐两种诊断方法，揭示前沿模型约85%的失败源于感知错误，并能独立于答案长度预测答案正确性。
en_tdlr: PRISM-BENCH is a benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated multimodal reasoning questions whose human-validated reasoning traces enable two diagnostics—a perception probe attributing ~85% of frontier-model failures to misperception, and trace alignment that predicts answer correctness (macro AUROC 0.66) beyond final-answer accuracy.
